# mindfulcn

> mindfulcn is a free collection of curated shadcn/ui themes built from Alex Cristache's mindful palettes. Preview themes on real components in light and dark mode, then copy tweakcn-ready CSS.

mindfulcn helps developers skip hours of color tweaking. Every theme is designed for harmony, accessibility, and semantic tokens, and exports in the format tweakcn expects. No account is required.

## Pages

- [Home](https://mindfulcn.vercel.app/): What mindfulcn is, how it works, features, and FAQs
- [About](https://mindfulcn.vercel.app/about): Origin story, credits, and how palettes are expanded
- [Dashboard preview](https://mindfulcn.vercel.app/dashboard): Live dashboard with charts, tables, and cards
- [Component gallery](https://mindfulcn.vercel.app/components): shadcn/ui components themed in place
- [Theme gradients](https://mindfulcn.vercel.app/gradients): Gradient swatches from the selected palette
- [Full LLM context](https://mindfulcn.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Complete theme catalog, FAQs, and usage notes
- [Theme catalog JSON](https://mindfulcn.vercel.app/api/themes.json): Machine-readable list of palettes

## Themes

Themes are selected with the `?theme=` query param (for example `/dashboard?theme=223`). Canonical URLs omit the query string.

- rustic forest (`083`)
- midnight cove (`095`)
- blush at dusk (`187`)
- anchored ember (`218`)
- indigo atelier (`223`)
- electric tide (`231`)
- still meadow (`280`)

## Key facts

- Product: free shadcn/ui theme gallery
- Palettes by: Alex Cristache
- Built by: vcheeze (Peter Chen)
- Compatible with: shadcn/ui, tweakcn, Tailwind CSS
- Price: $0, no account required
- License for themes: free for personal and commercial use
